audiences.label: Executive sponsor / steering committee
audiences.goal: Approve the recommendation and understand its business impact
cares_about: exactly what decision is needed from them
audiences.format: One headline sentence, at most 5 bullets, then a one-line ask.

audiences.label: Engineering lead / platform team
audiences.goal: Understand the design, interfaces and operational impact so they can plan the build
audiences.format: Short sections: Design, Interfaces, Ops and failure modes, Next steps.

audiences.label: Security, privacy and legal reviewers
audiences.goal: Assess data flows, controls and compliance obligations
cares_about: what data goes where, and where it is stored
audiences.format: Data flow summary, controls as bullets, residual risks, decisions needed.
